name: useADPFHintSession
summary: Active frame workload negotiation with Android Dynamic Performance Framework and Tensor EAS.
plain: Creates an active ADPF hint session with the Energy-Aware Scheduler to dynamically adjust CPU clock frequencies based on actual frame render workloads, eliminating stutter without wasting battery.
description: Interfaces directly with android.os.PerformanceHintManager (Android 12+ API 31+). Manages an active thread hint session allowing apps to report exact frame computation times in nanoseconds. This informs the kernel scheduler in real-time whether the workload is meeting its deadline (e.g. 16.67ms for 60Hz or 8.33ms for 120Hz), scaling frequencies up only when needed.

params.name: initialTargetDurationMs
params.desc: Initial target frame duration budget in milliseconds, defaulting to 16.67ms (60 FPS).

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether ADPF PerformanceHintManager sessions are supported on this device.

returns.name: targetFrameDurationMs
returns.desc: Current target frame render budget in milliseconds.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if hint session creation or reporting failed.

returns.name: reportWorkDuration
returns.desc: Reports actual computation duration taken by the render thread in nanoseconds.

returns.name: updateTargetWorkDuration
returns.desc: Updates target frame deadline in nanoseconds (e.g. dynamically switching refresh rates).

returns.name: closeSession
returns.desc: Closes the active ADPF hint session.

actions.name: reportWorkDuration(actualDurationNanos)
actions.desc: Reports frame workload duration to the Energy-Aware Scheduler.

actions.name: updateTargetWorkDuration(targetNanos)
actions.desc: Updates the target frame deadline in nanoseconds.

actions.name: closeSession()
actions.desc: Terminates the active ADPF hint session.

agentNote: Available on Android 12+ (API 31+). Directly drives Tensor DVFS (dynamic voltage and frequency scaling).
